newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NOL says APL to hit earnings.
newsitem.headline: NOL says APL to hit earnings.

text.p: Neptune Orient Lines Ltd (NOL) said on Monday its takeover of U.S. container carrier APL Ltd would have a negative impact on its earnings for 1997.
NOL chairman Herman Hochstadt told a news briefing on the merger the APL purchase would be funded by internal funds as well as existing credit lines from 12-13 banks.
"I don't think the impact, in terms of profitablity, will be very good for us this year because of the expenditure. It will not be positive for the bottomline," he said.
He declined to say what costs NOL would incur from the merger.
NOL's turnover is expected to be boosted to Singapore $6 billion (US$4,2 billion) when the merger is completed by the third quarter of this year, from S$1.93 billion in 1996.
